metadata.key_test: Headline Safeguard C confirmation at scale: high growth + low P1 = reversal, not consolidation (Bangladesh Aug 2024 collapse). Also tests P1 ordinal weakness across a near-tied floor gap.
metadata.notes: 1971 War of Independence scored 25 years on from a 1996 baseline. WGI given as legacy -2.5/+2.5 estimates and ranges, recorded in notes rather than as 0-100 indicator values; pillar scores are derived estimates.

pre_event.event_description: 1971 War of Independence (East Pakistan secession to form Bangladesh), scored on a 1996 baseline over 1996-2024.

context.neighbor_details: Regional India dynamic; 1971 bifurcated state separated by ~1,600 km of Indian territory.

Pakistan.notes: WGI Rule of Law (legacy -2.5/+2.5): 1996 = -0.63 (Pakistan's own max), 2000 = -1.00 (min), 2023 = -0.86. Govt Effectiveness 2024 = -0.60 (avg -0.62). HDI 2023 = 0.544 (168th, Low). Derived: low-P1 (P1 approx 0.20-0.25), with P5 (political stability) and P1 deteriorating. Resource rents low.

context.growth_trajectory: high sustained growth (6-8% in the 2010s, peaking ~8.1% FY2018-19)

Bangladesh.notes: WGI Rule of Law (legacy): 1996 ~ -0.8 to -1.0; 2000 = -1.15 to -1.19 (min era); 2023 = -0.50 (Bangladesh's own max). HDI 1990->2023: 0.397 -> 0.685 (+72.5%, one of world's largest gains, 130th Medium). Net ODA 2023 = 1.25% GNI. Resource rents very low (gas-dependent domestic). Derived: low-P1 (~0.20-0.25); P3 (life expectancy 74.7 yrs) and P4 (sustained 6-8% growth) rose materially. GDP per capita PPP overtook Pakistan ~2016-2020.

a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Bangladesh clearly outperforms Pakistan despite equal/lower P1.

Pakistan.outcome_summary: HDI 2023 = 0.544 (168th, Low). Persistent instability; P5/P1 deteriorated; GDP per capita PPP overtaken by Bangladesh ~2016-2020.

Bangladesh.outcome_summary: HDI 0.397 -> 0.685 (+72.5%); ~$450B economy with one of the fastest sustained growth records globally. August 2024 collapse: PM Sheikh Hasina ousted Aug 5, 2024 after a crackdown the UN OHCHR Fact-Finding Report (Feb 12, 2025) estimated killed up to 1,400 people between 1 July and 15 August 2024; interim government under Muhammad Yunus.

analysis.overall_assessment: 6 applicable predictions: 5 CONFIRMED, 1 PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED (a), 0 FALSIFIED. The single most important result of Run 2 for refining the framework.
safeguards_triggered: Safeguard C (reversal risk) - TRIGGERED for Bangladesh (PROBABLE), confirmed at scale by the Aug 2024 collapse
Safeguard B - TRIGGERED for the 1971 engineered bifurcation (low P1 -> violent fragmentation)
Safeguard D - TRIGGERED (Bangladesh near-encircled by India)
new_failure_modes_discovered: P4-growth illusion: high growth with low P1 predicts reversal, not consolidation - strengthens Safeguard C.
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Bangladesh is the canonical Safeguard C teaching case: a ~$450B high-growth economy reverted because GDP growth never converted into institutional delivery (rule of law near floor; democratic backsliding). P4 growth is not a substitute for P1.
proposed_framework_modifications: Treat Bangladesh as the canonical Safeguard C case and re-audit any dataset country scored as 'consolidating on growth' with sub-floor P1.
analysis.baseline_impact: Restates the P1 ordinal claim (gap must exceed WGI margin of error) - a refinement candidate to check against the 20-case baseline before adoption.
analysis.strict_recode_note: Strict re-code applied per run6 (post-hoc d-dimension -> PARTIAL; narrow-gap a-trajectory annotated with Mod4). Honest aggregate target ~62-78%.
